stat_system.name: SP
stat_system.note: Champions replaced EVs/IVs with Stat Points. At level 50 one SP is exactly +1 to that stat. Formulas live in pkcm.engine.stats.

clauses.species_clause: no two Pokemon sharing a base species
clauses.item_clause: no two Pokemon holding the same item -- hk confirmed in game
clauses.evasion_clause: moves that raise evasion are banned
clauses.source: Species and Item Clause are confirmed in game. Evasion Clause is carried over from mods/champions/rulesets.ts and is NOT confirmed -- no ranker party in the archive uses an evasion move, which is no evidence either way.

removed.sleep_moves_clause: Showdown's champions mod lists it; the game does not run it. hk confirmed Sleep Powder is usable, and 11 of 113 archived ranker parties (2400-2800) carry a sleep move -- Sleep Powder x10, Hypnosis x1.
removed.ohko_clause: Same. Three archived ranker parties carry a one-hit-KO move (Fissure, Horn Drill, Guillotine).

order: remaining HP as a share of that side's starting HP
time_over_decision.note: Tiers 2 and 3 are separate tests: equal shares need not mean equal amounts.

notes: Terastallization is absent from the M-B ruleset text; excluded from scope.
Legal species and Mega Evolutions live in regulation_m_b.json (generated by scripts/build_champions_data.py).
Singles 6->3 is an official Champions ranked format alongside Doubles 6->4.
Champions removes 194 of the moves Showdown's base data calls standard and changes the numbers on ~30 more; see overrides.json.

RULES COME FROM CHAMPIONS SOURCES ONLY. Showdown's champions mod is a mechanics reference -- it has the handler code -- but it runs its own ruleset and two of its clauses are not in the game. Anything about what a team may carry needs a Champions source: the pkmnchamps ranker archive, the 포케챔스 dex, the ROM data, or hk.
